 x0,y0,x1,y1=box; h=hsv[y0:y1,x0:x1]

  m=((h[:,:,0]<25)&(h[:,:,1]>100)&(h[:,:,2]>80)).astype(np.uint8)*255
 n,lab,stats,cents=cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(m,8)
 ids=np.argsort(stats[1:,4])[::-1][:10]+1
 print(name)
